area: Workflow Automation incidents in depth and AI Guard depth: incident drill-down (metadata only), the Workflow Automation audit log, closing incidents as false positives on the Bulk changes engine, the AI Guard page with LLM applications, credential metadata and Test a prompt, 17 new scored checks, and the sample tenant and snapshots for all of it
title: W8 zwa-aiguard: ZWA incident drill-down, bulk close of false positives, the ZWA audit log, AI Guard applications, credentials and a synthetic prompt test, and the page-only findings promoted into the scored assessment

checks.what: The incident drill-down calls get_incident_details, get_incident_triggers, change_history and get_generated_tickets only; get_incident_evidence and get_incident_transactions are never called anywhere; user, file name, client IP, metadata link, note text and quoted trigger content never reach an answer

Closing incidents goes through the four gates (write mode, writer, named assessor, typed phrase asked whatever the count), re-reads each incident (a changed plan writes nothing), names the assessor in each note, reads back, audits, and offers an Undo that records the reversal

Every new read is refused (400) before sign-in when its Scope page key is not ticked: incidents and the audit log need DLP and Workflow Automation not marked as another product, AI Guard needs AI Guard

Test a prompt accepts only an id from the synthetic catalogue; with no AIGUARD_API_KEY nothing is sent; an SDK error is replaced by a fixed sentence (no key echoed); the sample answers with a made-up detector and a snapshot sends nothing

AI Guard credentials are kept as metadata only (an allowlist of fields): a key, secret or token in a credential or provider answer never reaches the inventory, and application owners are counted, not listed

A snapshot keeps incident metadata only and reads no incident when Workflow Automation is marked as another product; the offline tenant answers the two read searches (a POST that changes nothing) and refuses incident writes on a snapshot

17 new scored checks (AIG.1-6, ZWA.1-4, DLP.IDX1-3, ZPA.BA1-4) give the expected verdicts on the sample, N/A when unlicensed, nothing read when not in scope; every section maps to the scope that runs it
Every new control has a help-catalogue entry (the extension copy byte-identical), the new features have What's new marks under 2026-10-31, the AI Guard page has no free-text prompt box

findings.title: The offline SDK client had no AI Guard service, so on the sample tenant and in snapshots AI Guard readiness reported the classic ZIA sign-in and no AI Guard page or check could work offline
findings.fix: OfflineSdkClient.aiguard (the SDK's AIGuardService over the offline executor, service type aiguard), /aiguard paths allowed in snapshots, sample AI Guard data

findings.title: The Scope page channel guard checked GET reads only: a read the API asks for with a POST (the Workflow Automation incident and audit searches) would have passed it unchecked through __getattr__
findings.fix: channel_scope.ScopedClient.post_read: only the two listed searches, gated by the Workflow Automation channel like a GET, refused when nothing is declared

findings.title: The SDK's IncidentDLPDetails.as_dict drops dlpIncidentTickets[].ticketInfo (ticket id and state)
findings.reason: An SDK model gap: the details show the ticket count and the tickets come from get_generated_tickets, which keeps ticketInfo

findings.title: Workflow Automation has no API to reopen a closed incident, so a closure cannot be reverted from the app
findings.reason: Undo records the reversal on each incident (label zme-fp-close=reverted and a note naming who reversed it) and the plan says the reopen is a portal step

findings.title: AI Guard policy detection (execute_policy) is legacy only and needs an AI Guard API key, not the OneAPI client
findings.reason: The key is taken only from the server's AIGUARD_API_KEY environment variable, never typed into a page, shown, logged or saved; without it nothing is sent and the page says where to set it
